objective.description: Executable subtask objective preserving the user's constraints.

context.description: Necessary parent context, assumptions, and upstream inputs; do not invent facts.

input_artifacts.description: Supplied or explicitly planned artifact references. Empty if none.

deliverable.description: Expected concrete output and relevant completion criteria.

depends_on.description: Other task IDs in this plan; no cycles or self references.

difficulty.description: Qualitative planning estimate, not an AA task difficulty measurement.

rationale.description: Brief task-grounded justification, including material uncertainty. For planner_estimated weights, name the applicable semantic anchor IDs and explain the chosen weights or why no anchor is a close fit.

source_task_id.description: Exact AA task ID only for the same benchmark task; empty for a new task.

task_weights.description: For planner_estimated, estimate all four relative capability weights using the rubric and semantic anchors. For either AA-anchor mode, copy one complete recorded reference fit. Use four nulls only for uncalibrated. Numeric weights must be finite, nonnegative, and sum to one. Planner estimates are heuristic requirements; AA-fit weights are small-sample predictive associations. Neither measures task difficulty or success probability.

calibration_anchor_id.description: ID of the recorded fitted AA anchor for AA-anchor modes only. Empty for planner_estimated and uncalibrated; mention semantic anchor IDs in rationale instead.

weight_source.description: Planner semantic estimate, exact AA reference-task binding, AA analogy transfer, or unknown. The legacy calibrated label denotes a regularized reference fit rather than validated difficulty or semantic requirement proportions. Planner estimates require empty source_task_id and calibration_anchor_id.
